o.text: Synonymous compound of yaraq + yasaq, the latter part being a loan from Middle Mongol ᠵᠡᠪᠰᠡᠭ (ǰebseg), cognate with Khalkha Mongolian зэвсэг (zevseg, “weapon”); not related to Azerbaijani yasaq (“prohibition”).
From Persian نامزد (nâmezad). The informal sense is semantic loan from Russian кандида́т (kandidát).
